question: Is the coordinate across the path after a valley-ridge inflection, in the overdamped limit, a swept pitchfork that chooses its product by the Kondepudi-Nelson law?

provenance.source: Transverse part of the minimal valley-ridge surface V = 8/3 x^3 - 4 x^2 + y^2/2 + x y^2 (y^2 - 2) of examples/ptsb/ptsb.py, with the path coordinate x as the control s (friction gamma = 1); the surface follows the form of the model family of Collins, Carpenter, Ezra and Wiggins, J. Chem. Phys. 139, 154108 (2013)

name: post-transition-state bifurcation, transverse coordinate
closure: overdamped motion across the path at friction gamma = 1 and kT = 0.01, the path coordinate s = x advancing through the valley-ridge inflection at s = 1/4
assumptions: the path coordinate is treated as an external control (no back-reaction of y on the motion along the path)
additive Gaussian noise of strength kT/gamma
